correctness.rationale: Under uniform unrestricted compositions of N, cut bits n=N-1 are iid fair; K=1+ones and M=1+longest zero run. Bernoulli differentiation gives Cov=-1/4 sum_{r>=1} partial_p Pr_p(L_n<r)|p=1/2. The avoidance generating function is (1-(qz)^r)/(1-z+p q^r z^(r+1)). Differentiating its dominant-pole residue uniformly for log2 n±3log2 ln n, with Rouché separation on |z|=3/2, gives -n epsilon_r' exp(-n epsilon_r)+ summable o(1) errors, epsilon_r=p q^r. Short-run disjoint-block tails are superexponentially suppressed and long-run pivotality tails contribute O((ln n)^-2). Reindexing lambda_r=n 2^(-r-1) yields Cov= -1/2[(log2 n-2)P({log2 n})+Q({log2 n})]+o(1), with P and Q as absolutely convergent dyadic series. Gamma Fourier coefficients imply P nonconstant, and longest-run variance bounded above and away from zero gives Corr=-Theta((ln N)/sqrt N). Independent exact recurrences give declining absolute differences through n=4096; numerical values alone cannot establish the o(1) uniform error.
